newsitem.title: UK: GDR REPORT-India drifts, Taiwan extends gains.
newsitem.headline: GDR REPORT-India drifts, Taiwan extends gains.

text.p: Indian global depositary receipts posted light gains on Monday following a mostly flat local market performance.
Traders said limited interest was shown in stocks amid continued political uncertainty related to the resignation of Bihar state minister Laloo Prasad Yadav.
The HSBC James Capel Indian GDR index JCEAI closed 0.11 points firmer at 84.27, a 0.13 percent rise, with the premium over the local market at 19.93 percent from 19.89 percent.
The Cazenove Indian GDR index added 0.10 points to 94.96 -- a 19.82 percent premium to the local market. It measures from midday on the previous trading day to midday today.
Bombay's benchmark index eased 8.33 points to 4,181.48.
Reliance lost 0.32 cents to $21.50/$22.50 and Hindalco collected 82 cents to $34.00/35.00.
Taiwanese GDRs rose again following extended gains in Taipei for technology shares.

Stocks in Taipei were driven to seven year highs by a buoyant high-tech sector, and traders said the local weighted index could son break the 10,000 point level after falling under five points short of the level on Monday.
The Capel Taiwan GDR Index added 2.11 points, or 1.50 percent, to 142.96, representing a discount to the local market of 2.69 percent from 2.49 percent.
Taiwan's weighted index added 0.55 percent on Monday.
The HSBC James Capel Korea GDR Index rose 0.57 points to 76.93 points, a premium of 48.43 percent over the local market.
